artifact_version: VN Companion RC29.130 · Travel Engine 25.7.3 Map Routing Hardening
capabilities_changed: Timeline Google Maps navigation now routes by verified street address instead of business-name + address, preventing listing-name mismatches such as Izakaya Maruco from producing an unresolved destination.
Day 2 afternoon now flows Vincom / The New Playground → Rue Miche L’Édition at Union Square B3 → LÚNE, with a Shopping Directory guide card and Shopping Route Map connectors.
Day 3 primary dinner is Izakaya Maruco at 19:30, confirmed via Instagram; Ốc Đào remains optional backup.
Adds Engine-level shared Documents capability to VN.
Documents root is the shared/default filing location; no ALL folder is rendered.
Participant folders are generated from TRIP_CONFIG and render only when populated.
Document filing is classification only and remains separate from uploader ownership and Studio booking-link management.
Existing VN collaborative Booking, cashback/payment, Qspa D1-D3 and itinerary contracts are preserved.
Preserves the six-category NZ Documents contract in VN.
Timeline attachment selection is now Day → Event instead of one whole-trip flat list.
Timeline event choices show time + title and only events from the selected day.
Keeps all six bottom navigation destinations on one row, including narrow mobile viewports.
VN currency converter defaults to 10,000 VND.
VN collaborative users can select Booking or Timeline links when uploading/editing Documents.
Document link editor hides Booking/Day/Event controls until their Attach to mode is selected.
Browser double-submit smoke restores its BOOKING_AUTHORITY wrapper between viewport runs.
Booking detail surfaces linked Documents and opens the linked file in Documents.
Documents renders cached local metadata before background sync and lazy-loads PDF.js only when a PDF is opened.
Guide Save is local-first and auto-syncs across devices through trip_guides; Timeline Publish does not own Guide.
Timeline TO NEXT STOP destination is derived from current Timeline order after move/add/delete/edit.
For a trusted route with walking time <=15 minutes, Timeline shows both Walk and Grab estimates; otherwise it shows Grab only.
Derived next-stop Directions opens Google Maps from the current stop to the derived next stop.
VN Timeline cards render start time only while retaining end time in itinerary data.
VN Directions resolve only from Vietnam-scoped address/map-query authority and fail closed instead of geocoding bare titles near the user home location.
Derived next-stop presentation is compacted to the NZ-style Timeline hierarchy.
VN Timeline Publish is enabled in Supabase for ccmv-vietnam-2026 using the existing Trip Studio credential.
Published snapshots hydrate Timeline/ITINERARY_DATA only; Guide, Booking, Documents, Expenses and Moments remain independent auto-sync authorities.
A final Timeline event that explicitly returns to Fusion derives TO NEXT STOP → Fusion Original Saigon Centre.
Timeline note/detail display removes a trailing full stop (。 or .) without altering stored schedule/address data.
Expenses adds a one-tap Settlement Checkpoint that restarts Current Balance from zero without deleting historical expenses.
Trip Total and Personal Spend remain lifetime trip figures while Current Balance counts only expenses after the latest checkpoint.
Settlement checkpoints auto-sync through the existing trip_expenses authority and can be removed without deleting expenses.
Editing a previously settled expense raises a checkpoint review warning instead of silently rewriting the settled position.
Simplifies Guide Studio to Place name, Address, Phone, Website, Opening hours, Description/About and Useful info.
Merges legacy Guide signature/highlights/worth/tips/practical/booking-note content into Useful info on edit and retires duplicate fields.
Makes Guide/Booking/Timeline resolve canonical Place contact/location facts through Guide Authority overrides.
Booking Important information absorbs cancellation, accommodation arrival instructions and activity lunch notes while preserving functional booking fields.
Timeline navigation prefers current shared Place address over stale item address snapshots.
Timeline saved/pending overrides no longer mask current-master placeId, bookingId, Guide linkage or related cross-surface relationship metadata.
Narrows destructive Trip Studio reset to Documents, Moments and Expenses only; itinerary, Booking, Guide, checklist, changed plans and trip settings are preserved.
Clear Trip Records deletes document cloud rows and uploaded document files in addition to Moments/photos and Expenses.
Adopts NZ browser-cloud isolation hardening so an explicit runtime enabled:false overrides baked-in Supabase enablement during browser tests.
Trip and Guide navigation omit empty categories/modules instead of rendering blank chooser pages.
Single-entry Stay/Restaurant/Spa booking categories direct-open the canonical Booking card.
Cu Chi booking title now reflects the purchased Half Day Tour only and removes the unpurchased City Tour option.
Documents shell Guide menu is aligned to the current VN Guide categories and removes the stale Activities entry.
Real browser release smoke disables production Supabase before application scripts execute.
Restores Quán Thuý 94 as planned Day 4 early lunch between PUSH PUSH and Thảo Điền Open List.
Links the Day 4 Quán Thuý Timeline event to the existing Guide place authority; Guide text remains user-editable and is not reset by release.
Rebases RC29.86 user-edited Day 4 Timeline overrides additively so existing Timeline edits survive while the Quán Thuý event is inserted.
TO NEXT STOP remains derived from resolved Timeline order; no separate Guide next-leg schedule is authored.
Browser release CI installs a deterministic FX fetch provider before app scripts and hard-fails any production FX network request; production live FX is unchanged.
Qspa planned visits are editable and preserved by cross-device booking sync.
Edit Booking is fixed in the booking detail header; mobile booking detail uses canonical full-width layout.
Day 2 Shopping Route follows verified walking order and resolves Mozaic Space with its exact Google Place ID.

release_status: RC29.130 CANDIDATE — Day 2 Rue Miche Shopping
changes: RC29.130: Added Rue Miche L’Édition as the planned Day 2 afternoon shopping stop, Guide card and Shopping Route Map leg between Vincom and LÚNE.
Pinned the browser Supabase SDK CDN dependency to exact version 2.117.2 instead of the floating @2 major tag.
Added CI tombstone coverage preventing retired bookings-runtime.js from re-entering any production HTML, service-worker, manifest, or dynamic-loader path.
Added single-release-identity CI coverage for VERSION, RELEASE, TRIP_CONFIG, build labels, service-worker cache token and HTML cache-busting tokens.
Added CI coverage that compares local HTML script dependencies and configured splash assets against the service-worker precache.
Removed orphan bookings-runtime.js while preserving booking status regression coverage in active runtimes.
Vercel deployment hygiene excludes TypeScript backend source.
Release identity and local cache-busting tokens are unified at RC29.115.
Precache now covers every local HTML script dependency plus the configured splash mark for cold offline startup.
Integrated documents-runtime.js and documents-folder-ui.js as Engine 25.7.2 shared modules.
Added VN Documents page and navigation entry.
Upload defaults to Documents root and can file under Christal, Crystal, Mero or Vivian.
Added trip_documents / trip-documents sync configuration scoped by VN trip_id.
No NZ RC25.7.33 production file was modified.
Replaced flat Documents Timeline target list with Attach to → Timeline event → Day → Event.
Added CI regression coverage for category add/edit round-trip, pin, links, viewer and authority parity.
Added trip_guides Guide sync authority and removed Guide overrides from publication payload.
Replaced authored Timeline next-stop destination rendering with order-derived next stop + Maps directions.
Added Vietnam-scoped route-location guard and map-query fallback to prevent ambiguous names resolving near Melbourne/Doncaster.
Timeline card time rail now renders start time only; underlying schedule ranges are preserved.
Compacted derived next-stop panel.
Enabled VN trip_publish_config and anonymous read policy for VN published Timeline snapshots.
Scoped publication hydration to ITINERARY_DATA only.
Added final-event return-hotel fallback for TO NEXT STOP when the authored final leg explicitly returns to Fusion.
Removed terminal full stops from Timeline note/detail presentation.
Added Settle to here to Expenses for trusted-group checkpoint settlement without per-person payment ticking.
Separated Trip Total from Current Balance and preserved full transaction history across settlement checkpoints.
Checkpoint records snapshot settled expense update versions so later historical edits are surfaced for review.
Audited Booking-to-Expense cashback flow: netTotalAUD remains preferred ahead of gross totalAmount when no explicit deposit is being recorded.
RC29.81 ownership consolidation: Guide renderer/editor parity, shared Place contact facts, Timeline canonical destination resolution, and Booking note consolidation.
Renamed the Trip Studio destructive action to Clear Trip Records and made its confirmation state the exact deletion scope.
Added Documents resetAll ownership for cloud rows, uploaded files and local document state.
Removed device-only itinerary/Booking/Guide/progress key clearing from reset-runtime.js.
Ported NZ explicit Supabase runtime disable precedence for deterministic browser isolation.
Hid zero-entry Trip modules/categories and direct-opened single-entry booking categories.
Changed Cu Chi canonical booking title to Cu Chi Tunnels Half Day Tour.
Replaced the stale Documents-page Guide menu with the current VN Guide menu.
Injected TRAVEL_ENGINE_SUPABASE enabled:false into every browser-release context before navigation.
Custom Split with a manual Total defers balance calculation until field exit.
Custom Split can build Total when Total is blank and supports clearing multiple fields.
Expense Transaction History preserves scroll position across background sync rerenders.
Expenses adds one Share Summary action with PDF and Excel choices.
Share Summary separates Lifetime Spending from Current Settlement Period after Settle to here.
Final Settlement includes only expenses after the latest settlement checkpoint; settled history remains visible for record.
PDF emphasizes transaction title, payer, Spending Summary and Final Settlement in bold.
Multiple Payers preserves a pre-entered Total as authority; payer-derived Total is used only when Amount was blank.
Foreign-currency Expense Save uses an available cached/current FX rate for immediate local commit and refreshes live FX asynchronously.
Multiple Payers and Custom Split controls are compacted for mobile; FX adjustment implementation text is hidden from user UI.
Expense Settle action moved into the Trip Total card.
Expense Transaction History defaults to five records with Show more / Show less.
Moment History defaults to five records with Show more / Show less.
Transaction-history payer and split identities render names without participant emoji; Edit/Delete emoji remain.
Flight summary records Terminal 2 for both MEL and SGN on VJ082 and VN781, with SGN T2 reflected in arrival/departure Timeline context.

RC29.125 (documented retroactively): multi-visit bookings send one valid ISO visit date/time to the typed bookings columns while the human-readable aggregate date/time travels in the payload (_displayDate/_displayTime) and is restored on read.

RC29.125 (documented retroactively): Booking Notes from a real remote row are authoritative for cross-device sync; a Booking save is only reported as synced after the remote row carries the user-edited Notes and plannedVisits.

RC29.125 (documented retroactively): plannedDays/plannedVisits are editable booking state fields; the Booking editor exposes per-visit Day/Date/Time fields; Booking Save commits locally first and queues remote sync afterwards.

RC29.126: remote verification of plannedVisits compares JSON semantics instead of raw JSON.stringify — object key order is ignored (Postgres jsonb may re-order keys), array/visit order and all values must still match. No change to Qspa transport, Notes authority, Supabase calls or the save lifecycle.
RC29.126: release metadata corrected (stale RC29.116 status and RC29.93 static-CI claims removed); trip-config.js header updated; stale ci-tests/__pycache__ removed.

RC29.130: Supabase browser SDK (2.117.2), PDF.js (3.11.174 + worker) and html2pdf.js (0.10.1) are now self-hosted as byte-exact npm copies (vendor-*.js) instead of loading from jsDelivr/cdnjs; no external script host remains.

RC29.130: service worker precaches the Supabase SDK, PDF.js and PDF.js worker so Documents PDFs and the sync client work on first launch after an update while offline; html2pdf.js is cached on first export use.
RC29.130: booking remote verification treats Notes as equal when only line-ending style or leading/trailing whitespace differs; real text changes still fail.
RC29.130: python CI syntax check no longer writes ci-tests/__pycache__; new release-metadata freshness test blocks stale RC/static-CI claims.
